name: AKAHANE ACADEMY
source:
After the break, you return to Akahane Academy! A school that is quickly becoming infamous for its strange students... Today you'll meet 3 new boys! Who may be taking a liking to you... And only you in particular.

[From [url=https://kekkonsnow.itch.io/akahane-academy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
休息结束后，返回赤羽学园！一所因奇怪的学生而很快变得臭名昭著的学校……今天你将遇到3个新男孩！谁可能会喜欢你……而且只有你特别喜欢。

[来自[url=https://kekkonsnow.itch.io/akahane-academy]itch.io[/url]]
